[[File:Willow logs detail.png|130x130px|left]]
'''Willow logs''' are logs, which can be cut from [[willow tree]]s using the [[Woodcutting]] [[skill]]. Cutting willow logs from a willow tree requires an [[axe]] and level 30 [[Woodcutting]] and grants 67.5 Woodcutting [[experience]] per log. Players can burn willow logs using the [[Firemaking]] skill and a [[tinderbox]]. This requires level 30 Firemaking and grants 90 Firemaking experience per log.

[[Members]] may also use the [[Fletching]] skill and a [[knife]] to carve willow logs into [[arrow shaft]], [[willow shortbow (u)]], [[willow longbow (u)]], [[willow shield]]s or [[willow stock]]s. This requires levels 30, 35, 40, 42 and 39 Fletching respectively and grants 15, 33.3, 41.5, 83 and 22 experience. However, you need 2 willow logs for the willow shield.

Willow logs are also used to travel to [[Varrock]] using the [[Balloon transport system]].

Willows can be a very cost-effective way of getting to 99 Firemaking. It takes no more than {{formatnum:{{Items Needed|Goal= 99|Level= 30|ItemXp= 90}}}} willows to get from 30-99 Firemaking.

6 willow logs can be used to light an [[Abyssal lantern (willow logs)|Abyssal lantern]], requiring 30 Firemaking. 

[[File:Cutting Willows.png|thumb|right|300px|A player chopping a willow tree.]]

==Experience from logs==
*Each log gives 67.5 [[Woodcutting]] [[experience]] when cut (Woodcutting level 30 required).
*Lighting a log gives 90 [[Firemaking]] experience (Firemaking level 30 required).
*Making an unstrung [[willow shortbow]] gives 33.3 [[Fletching]] experience and 33.3 additional experience when adding [[bow string]] (Fletching level 35 required).
*Making an unstrung [[willow longbow]] gives 41.5 Fletching experience and 41.5 additional experience when adding bow string (Fletching level 40 required).
*Making a full [[willow stock]] gives 22 Fletching experience (Fletching level 39 required).
*Making a [[willow shield]] requires two willow logs and gives 83 Fletching experience ([[Fletching]] level 42 required)
